purpose: Process a separately frozen expansion cohort to reach at least 20 cumulative accepted recent-source Temporal benchmark families without changing EXP-TEMPORAL-PRODUCTION-001.
interpretation: Operational benchmark production after observing the first cohort's yield. Report this cohort separately; it is not a preregistered estimate of conversion rate and does not identify the causal effect of a pipeline change.

source_policy.fixed_order: Six Nature records, two Science records, 47 PRL records with direct author-list checks, then four PRL records with collaboration-level author representation and exact DOI evidence.

time_window.date_rule: earliest_public_date is the earlier of journal publication and arXiv first submission; the fixed arXiv version must be public by the window end

candidate_retrieval_order: quoted full-title web search for unresolved records
record_linkage.identity_evidence: A publisher-asserted preprint relation or exact journal DOI in official arXiv metadata is direct identifier evidence. A changed-title candidate without identifier evidence requires documented official-metadata adjudication of complete authors and abstract or method content.

target.rule: Count at most one family per source paper, and only after a nonempty minimal ScienceCard, separate-context source-review retention, deterministic construction, and passing Identification and Discovery known-truth validation.
target.processing: Process all 59 frozen sources; do not stop when the cumulative target is reached and do not replace failures.
target.family_identifier_rule: The compiler uses frozen source order plus family_index_offset, yielding temporal_source_1001 through temporal_source_1059 and avoiding cross-cohort identifier collisions.

authoring_engine.runtime_model_label: unknown unless exposed by the session

review.execution: A Code Agent context that did not author the card reviews the fixed source packet and frozen ScienceCard.
review.independence_claim: Process separation only; this is not independent human or domain-expert review.
review.release_requirement: Human source review remains required before public benchmark release.

temporal_claim.reason: The authoring engine knowledge cutoff and immutable snapshot are not documented.
temporal_claim.prohibited_description: Post-cutoff, unseen, or contamination-free benchmark cases
